label: Rice
panel_countries: China, mainland (1); India (2); Bangladesh (3); Brazil (11); United States of America (13); Nigeria (14); Italy (34)
crop_map: SPAM 2010 v2.0 RICE (harvested area A, irrigated I, rainfed R; 5' summed to 10')
seasons_represented: one main season per cell (Sacks); multiple seasons not represented
heat_metric_and_outcome: T_crit 35 C = anthesis temperature (Yoshida 1981 Table 2.4; FAO-66 p.106); slope 0.07/C = spikelet fertility loss per C above 29.6 C, tissue temperature, IR64 growth-chamber study (Jagadish et al. 2007), applied above 35 C on T_eff

oil_or_processed_treatment: Rice and products + Rice (Milled Equivalent); rice bran oil is a separate FBS item (not counted)
usda_composition_mapping: Rice and products -> Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, unenriched (fdc 169756); Rice (Milled Equivalent) -> Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, unenriched (fdc 169756)
nutrients_counted: kcal, protein, fat (FAOSTAT); zinc, iron (USDA x food quantity)
proxies_and_approximations: K_y = maize value 1.25 (FAO gives no rice K_y; rice is FAO 'high' drought-sensitivity class vs maize 'medium-high'); heat slope from one chamber experiment; main season only (Rice.2 calendar unused)
expected_bias: heat exposure ~0 with monthly data (hot days hidden) -> rice vulnerability understated; K_y proxy is a lower bound
reviewer_signoff: pending (team reviewer to check parameter vs source, one calculation, interpretation)
